model_note: Canonical abstract cases only; adapt to the exact D5 schema without dropping conditions. Synthetic labels and bytes are not real product evidence.

canonical_valid_control.field_binding_rule: Each field has an evidence reference, exact evidence-byte SHA-256, and issuer label; each binding names the same product/build tuple.

cases.mutation: none; all six fields agree on synthetic product/build and evidence bytes hash correctly
cases.expected: STRUCTURE_READY_ONLY; must explicitly disclaim issuer authenticity, evidence sufficiency, custody, and product truth

cases.mutation: all six values null/unavailable
openharmony_release missing/null
product_build_id_or_image_version missing/null
source_branch_or_release_tag missing/null
locked_manifest_uri_plus_sha256_or_immutable_commit missing/null
product_name missing/null
board_or_device_target missing/null
change referenced evidence bytes but retain recorded digest
cases.expected: reject evidence binding; BLOCKED; never READY

cases.mutation: evidence reference contains ../ or equivalent traversal outside evidence root
evidence reference is absolute (POSIX and Windows drive/UNC forms)
in-root symlink points to a file outside evidence root
cases.expected: reject containment escape; BLOCKED; no outside-root bytes accepted

cases.mutation: in-root Windows junction points outside evidence root
cases.expected: reject containment escape; BLOCKED; if junction unsupported, NOT_RUN

cases.mutation: remove issuer/owner identity from one required evidence binding
one field's evidence binding names a different build ID from the other five
mix product name, release, board, branch/tag, or manifest bindings from two synthetic targets
set caller-supplied status=READY while one required field/evidence binding is absent
cases.expected: ignore/reject caller status; effective result WAITING or BLOCKED

cases.mutation: set caller-supplied status=READY with a hash mismatch
cases.expected: ignore/reject caller status; effective result BLOCKED

cases.mutation: issuer string exists but has no verifiable identity credential or trusted signature
cases.expected: at most STRUCTURE_READY_ONLY; output must not claim issuer verified/authentic

cases.mutation: manifest URI carries a syntactically valid SHA-256 but retrieved bytes/immutable commit cannot be resolved and recomputed
cases.expected: BLOCKED; format-valid digest alone is insufficient

cross_case_invariants: No status field supplied by the input can override failed or missing checks.
All six minimum fields and their evidence bindings must identify one product/build tuple.
Manifest identity must be immutable and its bytes or commit identity independently verifiable.
Evidence references must be resolved beneath the explicitly selected evidence root after canonicalization and reparse-point checks.
All outputs distinguish structural readiness from authentic issuer, evidence sufficiency, source custody, product inclusion, and product vulnerability conclusions.
